label: ZKTeco Standalone SDK (ZKAttendance / ZKLS)
_comment: Official ZKTeco PC-side enrollment SDKs require a support login at zkteco.com/en/SDK (no anonymous download). The DLLs ship inside the vendor's SDK package (e.g. ZK Browser / ZKCai installs). Drop the DLL + this manifest into enrollment-bridge\sdk\ and hit /sdk/rescan. Adjust export names to the exact SDK revision you received.
